description: This file defines the Metrics interface for tracking service performance metrics within the org.apache.ofbiz.base.metrics package. It includes method signatures for retrieving metric data such as name, service rate, thresholds, total events, and methods for recording service times and resetting metrics.

classes.name: Metrics
classes.description: Interface for objects that track service metrics related to performance monitoring.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the metric.

methods.name: getServiceRate
methods.description: Returns a moving average of the service rate in milliseconds.

methods.name: getTotalEvents
methods.description: Returns the total number of processed events.

methods.name: recordServiceRate
methods.description: Records the service time for a number of events.
